newsitem.title: USA: IPE oil futures drift down,NYMEX offers scant help.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures drift down,NYMEX offers scant help.

text.p: The NYMEX front-month contract gained some 15 cents in its first half hour of trade, not enough to lift London business.
"The problem seems to be the (NYMEX crude) falling just short of yesterday's high. It really needs to get above $20 before we'll see some fresh buying," said one broker.

While the American Petroleum Institute data was read as neutral to bullish for crude, rising gasoline stocks were a worrying signal for U.S. product markets that traditionally drive demand across the oil complex at this time of year.
"We are keeping an eye on the gasoline after their numbers were poor," said one player.
